## Problem and resulting change

Describe who needs this change and its observable result.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For scientific changes, state the
reference, assumptions, error norm, and tolerance. Explain any check not run.

## Contributor requirements

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or this is a documentation-only change.
- [ ] User documentation and examples reflect the change.
- [ ] Verified claims have evidence; unresolved claims are labeled.
- [ ] Credentials, sensitive data, and unlicensed artifacts are excluded.
- [ ] Compatibility changes and limitations are documented.

See `docs/quality.md` for the policy draft and its adoption status.
